artifacts.summary: Characterization of requirement (W): the closure-wide object splits into a syntactically bounded anchor layer (box is one bit per model, stab one bit per world-state cell -- box_time_invariant compiled) and an unbounded run layer; (S)'s construction is machine-checked NOT to be the soundness half (modelOf_incomplete via no_finite_width_sat; stab collapses at every Presented seam under nowUnique); costed 5-phase decomposition landing the anchor layer and a wired verdict probe, with the run layer recorded as blocked on three named obligations and no Decidable statement anywhere.

next_steps: Plan: Phase 1 box_time_invariant/box_global into PlusTruth.lean; Phase 2 wired probe w-soundness-shape-refuted.lean (modelOf_incomplete, stab_iff_of_presented_nowUnique); Phase 3 AnchorLayer.lean (cells, box/stab fixpoint equations, anchorCons_of_model, cells_card_le); Phase 4 README/theorem-index/ROADMAP/pins recording the run layer as blocked; no run-layer construction phases this round.

memory_candidates.content: In the L+ task semantics, box psi has ONE truth value per model: histories are time-shift closed (plusTruthAt_timeShift), so forall sigma, psi at (sigma,t) iff forall sigma, psi at (sigma,s). Per-time quantification over the slice for box does not exist; only stab varies, and only with the world state (stab_state_only).

Any model built by FrameOver.ofSlicedStep on a finite slice (e.g. RaySummary Realize.lean's frameOf/modelOf for every Cons presentation) validates NoFiniteWidth.Phi.neg, a Z-time non-validity, by no_finite_width_sat applied with R/fwd/bwd/M as explicit positional arguments. Finite-width constructions cannot be the soundness half of a complete lift to L+ validity.
